title: Caught Object Report JSON
description: A JS caught object representation. Default implementation is https://www.npmjs.com/package/caught-object-report-json.

truncated.description: Present when content or child reports were omitted to meet the configured whole-report size limit. On the root of an array report, this flag applies to the entire array.

instanceof_error.description: Base property. Result of `caught instanceof Error`. Omitted when it holds the expected value `true`; a missing field means `true`.

typeof.description: Base property. Result of `typeof caught`. Omitted when it holds the expected value "object"; a missing field means "object".

constructor_name.description: Optional base property. Result of `caught.constructor.name`. Not set if `caught` does not have a `constructor.name`. Set to `null` if accessing `caught.constructor.name` throws. Omitted together with `as_string` and `message` when the first line of `stack` is exactly `constructor_name + ": " + message` (or `constructor_name` alone for an empty message); when `as_string` is absent and both `constructor_name` and `message` are absent, a reader parses them from that line at the first `": "`.

message.description: Optional base property. Result of `caught.message`. Not set if `caught` does not have a `message`. Set to `null` if accessing `caught.message` throws. Omitted together with `as_string` and `constructor_name` when the first line of `stack` is exactly `constructor_name + ": " + message`; see `constructor_name`.

as_string.description: Base property. String representation of `caught` created using the format in `as_string_format` described in this schema. Set to `null` if creating string representation throws. Omitted when it equals the first line of `stack`; a missing field means the first line of `stack` (the first element when `stack` is an array). It is kept when `constructor_name` and `message` are both absent from the caught object although the line would parse, so that a reader does not derive fields the object never had.

as_json.description: Base property. JSON representation of `caught` created using the format in field `as_json_format` described in this schema. The default implementation shares a configurable whole-report size budget across all fields and children (100,000 UTF-8 bytes by default) and marks partial values with [truncated]. Set to `null` if creating JSON representation throws. Omitted when it holds the expected value `{}` (an object without enumerable properties, which is what a plain `Error` produces); a missing field means `{}`.

stack.description: Optional base property. Result of `caught.stack`. Not set if `caught` does not have a string `stack`. Set to `null` if accessing `caught.stack` throws. The default implementation stores `stack.split("\n")` as an array of lines (`parseStackToArray`, on by default); the raw string is stored when that option is off.

children_omitted.description: Optional base property. Present when this node has child sources that were not reported: "max_depth" for the maxDepth option, "max_children" for the maxChildren option, "max_size" for the maxReportSize option.

v.description: Optional root property. A version of report, added by the metadata option. `corj/v0.12` marks a report that omits expected values; the complete form is `corj/v0.12-full`.

as_string_format.description: Optional base property. A format of `as_string` field. Omitted when it holds the expected value "String".

as_json_format.description: Optional base property. A format of `as_json` field. Omitted when it holds the expected value "safe-stable-stringify-with-length-limit".

children_sources.description: Optional base property. Root only. Array of property names of caught object to collect into `children` property. Omitted when it holds the expected value ["cause", "errors"].

BASE_PROPERTIES_MIXIN.description: Base properties shared by all report objects. Since corj/v0.12 the default implementation omits fields that hold their expected value (see each property description). A missing field must be read as its expected value; `null` still means that producing the value failed.

children.description: Optional root property. Every nested error found through `children_sources`, flattened breadth-first. An object that appears more than once in the tree is reported once; later occurrences reference its `id` from `child_ids`.

id.description: Required array-element property. String id unique for this report, from the makeReportId option. The root is "root" by default.

path.description: Required array-element property. JSONPath from top-level caught object.

level.description: Required array-element property. Level of this object in the tree of nested error objects. Top-level is 0.

child_ids.description: Optional array-element property. IDs of the direct children of this node. A reference to the root uses the root id. Absent when there are none.
